messages:
Olivia Park: PartnerAtlas flagged entitlement overclaims in APAC yesterday — looks like ~600 customers had credits applied to 2025-03-01 that should be 2025-02-28. Can ops help triage?
Diego Ramos: quick q: is this duplication or just day-boundary shift?
partneratlas-bot: Exporter v2 sent rollups with date=2025-03-01 (local TZ Asia/Tokyo) but payload window_start/window_end missing.
Nina Patel: If they used calendar_date without timezone, our ingest assumes UTC midnight. That would shift +9h for JST and push some usage to next day.
Sam Green: That explains why customers see credits for the wrong billing day, not true duplicates. But we did also accept a second delayed batch from partner that included the same events shifted back to UTC -> could be counted twice for some customers.
marketplace-bot: ingestion: accepted 2025-03-01 rollup from partneratlas (no window_start) at 2025-03-02T01:12:05Z.
Olivia Park: Ops ask: stop auto-accepting rollups that omit window_start/window_end. Can we enforce that now?
Diego Ramos: yes, we can add validation to require ISO window_start/window_end. I'll open a short-lived rule to reject rollups without them.
Nina Patel: Data ask: run ledger diff across 2025-02-28 and 2025-03-01 for partneratlas. We need list of impacted accounts and token deltas.
Sam Green: I'll run a query, but add filter: only consider entries where partner_batch_date != computed_utc_date to catch timezone-shifted ones.
Olivia Park: PartnerAtlas — can you provide raw batch files with original timestamps and the exporter timezone?
partneratlas-bot: Uploading files now to S3: s3://partneratlas-exports/2025-03-02/debug-batches.zip. Exporter TZ: Asia/Tokyo. Rollups used calendar_date field and no window_start.
Diego Ramos: Two immediate work items: 1) Reject future rollups that lack window_start/window_end. 2) Add a temporary reconciliation flag to mark affected entitlements as "review_pending" so we don't bill or apply credits until we reconcile.
Nina Patel: Also add an admin job to normalize partner-supplied calendar_date into UTC windows using exporter TZ header when present. If header missing, treat as suspect.
Sam Green: Running diff now — result preview: 612 affected accounts, aggregate tokens mismatched 742,320, with ~18 accounts showing both a shifted credit and a later corrected rollup (potential dup).
Olivia Park: For those 18 dup accounts we need revocation. PartnerAtlas — can you generate a revocation with original event_ids or source_batch_ids?
partneratlas-bot: We will export event-level IDs and source_batch_ids within 4 hours. Revocation upload ETA 2025-03-02T12:00:00Z.
Diego Ramos: Engineering: I'll ship validation and the "review_pending" flag as a quick patch. Sam, can you provide the SQL to identify dup candidates so ops can auto-reverse where safe?
Sam Green: SQL gist incoming. It matches on (customer_id, partner_event_hash, nominal_tokens) and checks overlapping windows.
Nina Patel: Long-term: update partner contract spec — require window_start/window_end in ISO8601, include exporter_timezone header, require rollup_id and source_batch_ids, and discourage calendar_date-only rollups.
Legal Team: we'll update contract addendum and notify partners of the stricter ingest rules. Drafting now.
Olivia Park: Customer comms: short notice to impacted customers: "We identified some credits applied to an adjacent billing date due to partner export timezone mismatch. We're reconciling and will adjust bills if needed; no action required." Nina please coordinate with legal.
partneratlas-bot: Revocation and detailed event exports uploaded: s3://partneratlas-revokes/2025-03-02/revokes-2025-02-28.json. Signed link sent to eng@redwood.
Sam Green: Diff run with revokes applied: 612 affected accounts, 594 corrected automatically, 18 flagged for manual review (small token gaps). Reversals queued.
Diego Ramos: Patch deployed to staging; validation rejecting rollups w/o window_start; review_pending flag added. Will roll to prod after 1hr smoke tests.
Nina Patel: I'll follow up with a post-mortem doc and spec changes. Also recommend adding a partner onboarding checklist item for timezone handling.
Olivia Park: Thanks team. Closing ops: keep this thread open for any stragglers. If you spot similar rollups from other APAC partners in the last 30 days, tag here.
Diego Ramos: will monitor logs for similar patterns (calendar_date with no window_start).
Olivia Park: End of thread."
